name: agent-wrangler
description: Monitor all your AI agent sessions (Claude Code, more later): who is busy, who is waiting on you, who is done. Click to view live or resume.

commands.title: Agent Wrangler: Resume Session in Terminal…
Agent Wrangler: Reveal Transcript in Finder…

enumDescriptions: Open the dashboard as an editor tab, in the main editor area.
Open the dashboard in the bottom panel, next to Terminal.
agentWrangler.dashboardLocation.description: Where the dashboard opens. The other location stays available: the bottom panel view is always contributed, and the editor tab can be reopened from the command palette.

agentWrangler.openOnStartup.description: Open the dashboard automatically when a window starts. A dashboard tab restored by VSCode is left as it came back.

agentWrangler.claudeBinaryPath.description: Binary used when resuming a session in a terminal (claude --resume <id>).

agentWrangler.stuckThresholdSeconds.description: A busy session with no transcript writes or hook events for this long is shown as POSSIBLY STUCK. Keep it generous: the model is silent while thinking or writing a large file, routinely for 2–6 minutes.

agentWrangler.endedWindowHours.description: Show ended sessions whose last activity is within this window.

agentWrangler.maxEndedSessions.description: Maximum number of ended sessions to show.

agentWrangler.notifyOnWaiting.description: Show a toast notification when a session flips to WAITING ON YOU.

agentWrangler.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Reconciliation poll interval (pid liveness, staleness, missed file events).

scripts.install-local: npm run package && "${VSCODE_CLI:-/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin/code}" --install-extension agent-wrangler-$npm_package_version.vsix --force && date > .dev-reload
